header.name: Social Innovation, Corporate Social Responsibility and Sustainable Development
header.description:
For India, the aspiration of sustainable development is deeply tied to its ability to merge technology with traditional knowledge through social innovation. The country’s rich heritage of indigenous practices offers sustainable solutions that have stood the test of time. By integrating these practices with modern technology India can address pressing challenges like climate change, resource scarcity, and rural development. Social innovation that fosters this synergy not only ensures more environmentally friendly and culturally sensitive solutions but also empowers local communities, promoting inclusive and sustainable. Several initiatives such as Digital India, Niti Ayog's Atal Innovation Mission, tax exemptions, funding and incubation support are all geared towards creating a nurturing ecosystem of start ups and innovations. Also the emerging focus on Corporate Social Responsibility and corporate philanthrophy has emerged as a critical link combining social innovation, and CSR strategies towards more sustainable forms of development.

This course will have students understand the lanscape of social innovation, its critical need for a country like India, where need for combining new age technology with traditional knowledge is key. They will identify the problem, articulate innovation pathway. This course will also provide an interdiscplinary perspective to Corporate Social Responsibility and emerging models of CSR practices across business enterprises. The program will enable the participants to understand through indepth case studies analysis and best practices- sustainability challenges, tools, CSR and sustainable development approaches. Participants will learn to see how businesses can progressively contribute to dealing with development challenges through innovation and creativity. Besides, all participants will work on individual and group projects emphasizing the design of sustainable solutions by integrating key learning from the program.
